about.title: About
about.text: I’m a software developer from Germany with several years of experience building software for different purposes. I enjoy creating full-stack applications as well as Minecraft plugins, always focusing on clean, reliable, and efficient solutions.

techStack.title: Java Ecosystem
techStack.description: High-performance server-side applications and plugins with a clean, maintainable codebase.

techStack.title: Paper & Velocity API
techStack.description: Built for the latest server and proxy APIs. Paper Forks like PurpurMC are also supported.

techStack.title: Databases
techStack.description: All plugins support MySQL and MongoDB, so they fit into any server architecture.

techStack.title: Modern Web Technologies
techStack.description: Using React / Next.js for fast and next-gen fullstack apps.

techStack.title: Clean and beautiful design
techStack.description: Tailwind CSS and RadixUI (shadcn) for modern and consistent UI/UX.

techStack.title: Open Source
techStack.description: All free plugins are open source. Paid plugins ship with their source code.
